第94章:万蛊滔天，苗疆定蛊-《道士下山之749局》

外坛死寂，残骨铺地。

数十根阴森鬼柱崩裂倾倒，断裂石柱横七竖八散落外坛地面，柱内囚禁的万千冤魂被雷光净化、符箓超度，化作缕缕青烟消散在山巅寒风之中。最后一批甲贺忍者尽数伏诛，黑衣尸体倒在咒纹焦土之上，血腥混杂煞气，弥漫整座外坛。

众人踏过残破咒纹，稳步走向第二重中坛。

外坛与中坛之间，立着一圈丈高黑石围墙，围墙缝隙不断涌出浓黑毒瘴，瘴气粘稠如墨，落地腐蚀土石，散发刺鼻腐腥恶臭。墙内蛊池翻滚沸腾，黑水咕嘟作响，无数凶蛊在池中交织蠕动，密密麻麻、层层叠叠，看得人头皮发麻。

漆黑蜈蚣、血色毒蝎、鳞甲蛊蛇、腐骨飞虫，还有数种关外罕见的极地寒蛊，全部被九菊一派驯养在此。蛊虫叠堆、毒草丛生，地气倒灌，阴气饲蛊，硬生生造出一片绝命蛊域。

“万蛊绝阵。”钱丹驻足围墙之外，秀眸凝重，指尖轻轻颤动，“以龙脉散逸阴气为养料，以百种剧毒灵草为培育基底，把整座中坛改造成天然蛊炉。这里的蛊虫，每一只都浸染龙脉煞气，毒性远超寻常邪蛊，咬中一口，血肉溃烂、灵气封脉。”

雾瘴深处，缓缓走出五道黑衣人影。

五人皆身着绣黑蛊纹路的九菊服饰，面色惨白，双目无神，周身萦绕粘稠蛊雾，胸口纹着血色蛊印，是九菊一派仅存的五名顶尖养蛊师。为首一人中年妇人，颧骨高耸，嘴唇薄冷，袖口挂满蛊囊，周身蛊气厚重压迫，修为远超被俘的织田美子。

“中土苗疆蛊女，竟然敢闯我九菊万蛊坛。”中年妇人声音沙哑干涩，舌头偏长，透着非人诡异，“织田美子废物一个，连区区幽谷都守不住，你们能走到这里，倒是出乎我的意料。”

钱丹眸光微冷：“九菊邪蛊，滥生滥养，以活人血肉饲蛊，以山川地气炼毒，本就违逆天道。今日我便以正统苗疆医蛊，破你万蛊绝阵，拔尽山中毒根。”

“可笑。”妇人冷笑一声，抬手轻轻拍掌，“万蛊听令，屠尽来人。”

嗡——

中坛之内，蛊池骤然沸腾，黑水炸裂，漫天蛊虫冲天而起，密密麻麻遮蔽视线，如同黑色潮水，朝着众人疯狂扑杀而来。虫鸣刺耳，振翅声响彻山巅，腥臭风压得人呼吸滞涩。

漫天凶蛊，铺天盖地，杀意滔天。

“全员戒备，不要脱离护身光罩！”胡九郎沉声下令，“李安琪立石墙封瘴气，杨瑞布结界挡蛊潮，其余人护住钱丹，由她主导破蛊，不要擅自出手打乱蛊势！”

众人立刻照做。

李安琪双手虚引，山巅黑石浮空堆砌，两道厚重石墙横亘中坛入口，硬生生挡住最先冲来的一层蛊潮；石墙表面覆上纯净山石灵气，凡触碰到墙体的蛊虫，瞬间躯体僵硬、毒腺枯萎，簌簌坠落。

杨瑞抬手抛出八枚法牌，八面镇邪结界瞬间成型，笼罩全队周身，结界灵光洁白柔和，隔绝毒瘴、阻隔蛊毒，不让一丝瘴气侵入肉身。

范梦雪雷光内敛，不随意大范围轰击，避免炸裂蛊池、扩散剧毒黑雾；王欣欣、茉沫收起大范围暗器，只以细针精准点杀突破防线的巨型凶蛊；李二牛仙家灵光外放，护住后路，防止蛊虫绕后偷袭。

Chapter 94: Thousands of poisons are overwhelming, Miaojiang is determined to control the poison - "749 Game of the Taoist Priest Descending the Mountain"

The outer altar is deathly silent, with broken bones covering the floor.

Dozens of ghastly ghost pillars collapsed and collapsed, and the broken stone pillars were scattered on the ground of the outer altar. Thousands of innocent souls imprisoned in the pillars were purified by thunder and saved by talismans, and turned into wisps of blue smoke and dissipated in the cold wind on the mountain top.The last batch of Koga ninjas were all killed, and the black-clothed corpses fell on the scorched earth with curse patterns. The blood mixed with evil spirits filled the entire outer altar.

Everyone stepped through the broken curse patterns and steadily walked towards the second middle altar.

Between the outer altar and the middle altar, there is a foot-high black stone wall. Thick black poisonous miasma is constantly pouring out from the gaps in the wall. The miasma is as thick as ink, corroding the earth and stone when it falls, and emitting a pungent putrid stench.The Gu pool inside the wall was rolling and boiling, the black water was gurgling, and countless vicious Gu were intertwined and squirming in the pool, so densely packed and layered that it made one's scalp numb.

Black centipedes, bloody poisonous scorpions, scaly poison snakes, rotten bone flying insects, and several polar cold poisons that are rare outside the customs are all domesticated here by the Jiuju sect.There are piles of poisonous insects, poisonous weeds, earth energy flowing backwards, and yin energy feeding the poisonous insects, creating a lifeless poisonous realm.

"Ten Thousand Gu Arrays." Qian Dan stopped outside the wall, his beautiful eyes solemn, and his fingertips trembled slightly, "Using the Yin energy dispersed from the dragon veins as nourishment, and using hundreds of highly toxic spiritual grasses as the cultivation base, the entire central altar was transformed into a natural Gu furnace. Every single one of the Gu worms here is imbued with the evil energy of the dragon veins, and its toxicity is far more toxic than ordinary evil Gu. If you bite one, the flesh and blood will fester, and the spiritual energy will seal the veins."

From the depths of the fog, five figures in black slowly walked out.

The five of them are all wearing Jiuju costumes embroidered with black Gu patterns. Their faces are pale, their eyes are lifeless, their bodies are surrounded by sticky Gu mist, and their chests have bloody Gu seals. They are the only five remaining top Gu cultivators of the Jiuju sect.The leader was a middle-aged woman with high cheekbones, thin cold lips, and her sleeves were covered with poison sacs. The poison energy around her body was heavy and oppressive, and her cultivation level far exceeded that of the captured Oda Miko.

"The Gu girl from the Miao border of China dared to break into my Nine Chrysanthemums and Ten Thousand Gu altar." The middle-aged woman's voice was hoarse and dry, and her tongue was too long, revealing an inhuman weirdness. "Oda Miko is a useless person. She can't even defend a small valley. The fact that you can come here is beyond my expectation."

Qian Dan's eyes were slightly cold: "Nine chrysanthemum evil poisons are grown and raised indiscriminately. They use the flesh and blood of living people to feed their poisons, and they use the energy of mountains and rivers to refine their poisons. This is against the will of heaven. Today I will use the orthodox Miao border medical poisons to break through your array of poisonous poisons and remove all the poisonous roots from the mountains."

"It's ridiculous." The woman sneered, raised her hand and clapped her hands gently, "Wan Gu obeys the order and slaughters everyone who comes."

Buzz——

In the middle altar, the Gu pool suddenly boiled, the black water exploded, and Gu worms rose up into the sky, densely covering the sight, like a black tide, rushing toward everyone to kill them.The chirping of insects is harsh, the sound of flapping wings echoes through the mountain tops, and the smelly wind makes people's breath sluggish.

The sky is filled with vicious poisonous poisons, overwhelming the sky and the earth, and the murderous intent is overwhelming.

"Everyone is on alert, don't leave the protective shield!" Hu Jiulang ordered in a deep voice, "Li Anqi set up a stone wall to seal the miasma, Yang Ruibu made a barrier to block the tide of poison, and the others protected Qian Dan, and she took the lead in destroying the poison. Don't take action without permission to disrupt the poison!"

Everyone immediately followed suit.

Li Anqi raised her hands, and the black stones on the top of the mountain were piled up in the air. Two thick stone walls stretched across the entrance of the middle altar, blocking the first wave of Gu. The surface of the stone wall was covered with pure mountain stone spiritual energy. Any Gu insect that touched the wall would instantly stiffen its body, wither its poison glands, and fall down.

Yang Rui raised his hand and threw eight magic cards, and the eight-sided evil-suppressing barrier instantly formed, covering the entire team. The aura of the barrier was white and soft, blocking poisonous miasma and poison, and preventing even a trace of miasma from invading the physical body.

Fan Mengxue kept her thunder light restrained and did not bombard randomly in a large area to avoid exploding the Gu pool and spreading the poisonous black mist; Wang Xinxin and Momo put away their large-scale concealed weapons and only used fine needles to accurately kill the giant vicious Gu that broke through the defense line; Li Erniu's fairy family's spiritual light was released outward to protect the retreat and prevent the Gu from sneaking around.
